cohort: 54 infants with congenital heart disease who underwent a thyroid function test within 100 days of birth.
finding: Two-thirds of CHD infants in this study experienced thyroid dysfunction (53.7% transient, 13.0% permanent) within 100 days of birth, with lower birth weight and exposure to thyroid disrupting medications and/or iodine contrast media potentially contributing to transient dysfunction.
birth_weight: Infants with transient thyroid dysfunction had lower birth weight.
